Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class WatchlistMatchAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.WatchlistMatchAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
WatchlistMatchPort
@Component public class WatchlistMatchAdapter extends Object implements WatchlistMatchPort
JPA-backed implementation of WatchlistMatchPort.

Converts between the immutable WatchlistMatch domain record and the mutable WatchlistMatchEntity JPA entity.

The findByUser(java.lang.String, int) method first retrieves the user's watchlist item IDs via WatchlistPort, then queries matches for those items.
